trans-unit.resname: CAM['G-code inserted before the rotary axes move, and before a tilted work plane is aligned to with G53.1. Put the moves that bring the tool clear of the part here, in machine coordinates: G53 G0 Z0 lifts the tool to machine Z zero; G91 G28 Z0 followed by G90 references it. Left empty, nothing clears the part before the table turns, and the sanity check says so.']
trans-unit.source: G-code inserted before the rotary axes move, and before a tilted work plane is aligned to with G53.1. Put the moves that bring the tool clear of the part here, in machine coordinates: G53 G0 Z0 lifts the tool to machine Z zero; G91 G28 Z0 followed by G90 references it.
